# Exim Pharma

> > Polish pharmaceutical manufacturer specializing in dietary supplements, medical devices, and contract manufacturing with private label solutions for human and animal health.

Exim Pharma is a comprehensive pharmaceutical producer offering contract manufacturing, private label development, and branded product lines including Rainbovit, SupFertil, Goodvit, and MyPupillo. The company manufactures dietary supplements in multiple forms (capsules, tablets, drops, powders) and EU-compliant medical devices for both human and animal markets.

## Key Topics

- Dietary supplements
- Contract manufacturing
- Private label
- Medical devices
- Probiotics
- Fertility supplements
- Vitamins and micronutrients
- Rainbovit brand
- SupFertil brand
- Goodvit brand
- MyPupillo brand
- Pet supplements
- Pharmaceutical production
- Supplement forms
- Health indications

## Product Catalog

- [Product Catalog](https://www.eximpharma.eu/sklep): Product catalog: Rainbovit, SupFertil, baby and fertility supplements
- [Human Health Products](https://www.eximpharma.eu/kategoria-produktu/produkty-dla-ludzi): Human health supplements: probiotics, vitamins, medical devices
- [Pet & Animal Products](https://www.eximpharma.eu/kategoria-produktu/produkty-dla-zwierzat): Pet supplements and feed mixtures: MyPupillo brand for dogs and cats

## Manufacturing & Production

- [Dietary Supplement Production](https://www.eximpharma.eu/kategoria-produktu/produkty-dla-ludzi/suplement-diety): Dietary supplement manufacturing: capsules, tablets, drops, powders
- [Medical Device Manufacturing](https://www.eximpharma.eu/kategoria-produktu/produkty-dla-ludzi/wyrob-medyczny): Medical device manufacturing meeting EU and national standards
- [Animal Feed Mixtures](https://www.eximpharma.eu/kategoria-produktu/produkty-dla-zwierzat/pasze-i-mieszanki): Animal feed mixtures enriched with minerals and vitamins

## Health Indication Categories

- [Immune Support Products](https://www.eximpharma.eu/kategoria-produktu/produkty-wg-wskazania/odpornosc): Immune support supplements: Rainbovit C, D3, probiotics
- [Fertility & Potency Supplements](https://www.eximpharma.eu/kategoria-produktu/produkty-wg-wskazania/potencja): Fertility and potency supplements: SupFertil, Vigo ONE XL, OVALA
